title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.0037266288 (+0.0000005264099 over #7682’s upper) by splitting one helper at chart 595
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The complete sixteen-call signed construction gives **κ ≥ 0.0037266288** under the five assumptions of the selected #7000 application. Its directed lower exceeds **#7682’s directed upper of 0.0037261023901 by 0.0000005264099**. Please review this exact word and its application for conditional frontier admission. [Certificate, receipts and replay](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/tree/f55fc1434436ffa1c6d064a29fc56812044b3157/research/p104-banked-chart595-split)

| Complete signed caller | #7682 | Chart 595 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Paid recursive placements | 101,824 | 101,824 |
| Productive targets | 21,152 | 21,168 |
| Raw crossing, directed interval | (0.0037261023900, 0.0037261023901) | (0.0037266288769, 0.0037266288770) |

Eight previously paid arrivals recover an arbitrary old helper input at chart 595. Its original owner 281 takes the rank-one return there. A distinct owner 1501 supplies a fresh input to ten later departures and receives the rank-eight return at chart 127. The rank-nine return surrendered in each call is included. The complete price change is `+16 H₁ + 16 H₈ − 16 H₉`. The added owner, common-chart scalar arithmetic, full-array conversions, physical backing and retirement are charged.

## Task and overlap

This refines the `p104-side-correction` task to one banked helper-subspace split. The scientific base is canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The parent is #7682 at `1b4a4d6f9370b8c93b3f769a6229a9111ef3940e`, canonical graph `1f082936ada08b5138b7d13e33368bd21c6f46632c5319a348e2f2a8e0021150`. The new canonical graph is `d5dab11bb773bf5beb8ae2998be1282b243e2d1606c5257896a037c9b52c5c3b`. Its 6,142 paid edges retain their ordered charts and relative execution order. The exact caller SHA-256 is `62d94fb992acab0a71c3d12f22be4ce63f4f65e5cbe3f420b93aa1393ffa8dcf`. [Investigation and scoped finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19707199)

The separate prerequisite commit `0eabc624a9bc9ed2847719efd63390db4d297df4` reuses the historical CI repair from #7257 already carried by #7682. Its five affected files match the published repair. The second commit contains the entire scientific change in `research/p104-banked-chart595-split/`.

## Validation

From the repository root with CPython 3.12, run

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-banked-chart595-split
```

A cold run on committed head `f55fc1434436ffa1c6d064a29fc56812044b3157` passed all three registered stages in 239.14 seconds on CPython 3.12.3, with peak child RSS 595,800 KiB. The stages cover the full rational forward and adjoint operators, the fifteen predecessor pivot observations, every main and helper return, the physical catalogue, and four complete native executions over two primes. Changing the injection sign at slot 102698 changed 83 outputs. A phase error at prefix slot 95743 changed 46, including the early owner.

The ordinary checker visits 8,738,317 nonzero basis products on the changed word. Its chart-595 cut writes the old public output before the first fresh-input read. The caller uses 9,151 numeric homes per native call within the existing 15,290 cap, plus four separately charged guarded streams. The joined replay checks all 54 strict and four functional outer predicates. A separate outward-rounded price evaluation finds that adding one paid rank-one job would erase the gain.

## Credit and remaining obligations

Ali Romman supplied the helper-group basis construction in #5599 and the banked pivots in #7674. The earlier meeting work in #5718 and #5751, SYLforge and DreamingOfClouds' caller lineage in #7669, the role-230 recipient in #7682, and the grid and liveness work in #7680 and #7681 informed this construction. The package retains notices and exact source pins. Clear1nsight prepared this contribution with substantial OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro assistance. The independent checks here are computational and mathematical reviews performed with AI assistance.

The five standing assumptions concern native realization at all column multiplicities, owned storage and erasure, compiler closure, fixed-tape precision and movement, and analytic recovery. The complete uniform multiplier, formal-kernel proof, independent human review and maintainer admission remain open.

## Open next questions

For admission, independently replay the early public installation, the factor-seven divisions on the exact grid, and the funded outer inequalities on this head. For further stock reductions, the next concrete question is which snapshots can share a home while both an ancestor and its active child retain addressable backing.
